# Brendon Vetuskey
## Brendon Vetuskey
### Signature
Despite only having worked at Mattel since 2007, Brendon's involvement with Hot Wheels stretches to 1998, when he designed the Scream Machines , keychains with lights and sounds replicating Hot Wheels cars, for a company called Kiddesigns. Prior to working at Mattel, he worked at Jakks Pacific.
